admission_price: Regular Admission: $16.50 + tax online, $18.50 + tax in person (ages 3+, includes all attractions); September Weekends and Weekday Adventure: $14.50 + tax online, $16.50 + tax in person; Season Pass: $42.50 + tax; Groups of 20+ receive 10% off
activities: Giant Corn Maze; Pumpkin Patch; U-Pick Sunflowers; Pony Rides; Petting Farm; Wagon Ride; Pedal Karts; Pig Races; Corn Pits; Hay Pyramids; Rubber Duck Races; Campfires; Birthday Parties; Field Trips
season_dates: September 11 - November 1, 2026. Fridays: 3pm-9pm; Saturdays: 9am-9pm; Sundays starting in October: 1pm-6pm. Weekday Adventure on Sept. 29, Oct. 7, Oct. 15 (9am-1pm). Homeschool Education Days: Thursday, September 17th and Friday, October 16th (9am-1pm)
extra_notes: Admission required for all guests age 3+. Food, animal feed, and items to take home available at extra cost. Waivers required (can sign online or at arrival). No pets allowed except ADA service animals. Groups of 50+ can reserve special weekday times with discounted admission. Campfire pit rentals ($50 + tax) and party tent rentals ($40 + tax) available. Field trips available with group pricing ($8-$10 per student depending on group size). School FUNdraiser Nights available at $8 per guest. No Halloween costumes allowed. Rain policy: farm stays open for light rain; check social media for heavier rain updates. Free parking including for buses. No refunds on tickets.
